payload.claim: No test ever reaches the `except Exception as exc:` block at line 782 with `resolution_error is None`, so the `if resolution_error is None: raise` guard at line 783 is dead code as far as the suite can see. Deleting that guard (and its comment) so the handler unconditionally prints `f"batch: the queue could not be resolved: {exc}"` and returns 2 keeps all three new tests and the whole existing suite green, because every test that drives an exception into this except block does so with `resolution_error` already set (via a faked `_resolve_queue` raise) and every test that exercises the ordinary path has `run_batch` return a string rather than raise. A real bug elsewhere in `run_batch` (e.g. a `ledger` call) that raised with `resolution_error` still `None` would, after this edit, be silently mislabelled 'the queue could not be resolved' and swallowed at exit 2 instead of reaching `main`'s catch-all as the diff's own comment says it must.
